parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal plywood shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: A middle plywood shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage levels for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary or adjustable depending on design.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: Another internal plywood shelf within the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored objects and helps in organizing the cabinet interior.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during normal operation.

parts.name: Shelf 4
parts.Basic_description: The topmost internal shelf of the cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the upper storage surface for items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 1
parts.Basic_description: A front MDF door panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the contents of the cabinet, providing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 2
parts.Basic_description: Another MDF door panel located on the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the upper storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 3
parts.Basic_description: A lower MDF door panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It conceals and protects the lower storage area.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 4
parts.Basic_description: Another MDF door panel located on the lower section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the bottom storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.
